insert into contact(`room_id`,`uid`,`last_msg_id`,`active_time`) values
(#{roomId},#{uid},#{msgId},#{activeTime})
on DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `last_msg_id`=GREATEST(COALESCE(`last_msg_id`, 0), VALUES(last_msg_id)), `active_time`=GREATEST(COALESCE(`active_time`, '1970-01-01'), VALUES(active_time))
